description.text: The core of materials processing engineering lies in altering the shape, size, structure or properties of materials through physical, chemical or mechanical means, in order to meet the usage requirements of specific products. The research focuses include: The process principles during material processing (such as the crystallization laws of metals after melting, the flow characteristics of plastics after heating);The relationship between processing techniques and material properties (such as how forging can enhance metal strength by refining grains);The design and optimization of processing equipment (such as parameter adjustment of 3D printers, automatic control of rolling mills);Quality defect control during the processing process (such as prevention of cracks during welding, elimination of gas pores in castings). The difference between it and materials science lies in the following: Materials science focuses more on "the composition and structure of the materials themselves", while materials processing engineering focuses more on "how to use processes to transform materials into products".

duration.text: The Materials Processing Engineering at Northwestern Polytechnical University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

Scanned copies of the semester/academic year transcripts for each period of the undergraduate study. 4. Recommendation letters provided by 4 experts or above at the associate professor level.5. The applicant's study plan for pursuing a master's degree. 6. Chinese (HSK) / English (IELTS or TOEFL or Duolingo or PTE) language proficiency certificate; 7. No criminal record certificate (valid within 6 months); 8. Letter of Acceptance from the Supervisor:

requirements.text: 1. Physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and without any physical or mental disorders that affect normal learning). 2. By September 1, 2025, the applicants for the master's program should be no older than 30 years of age. 3. Educational Requirements: As of September 1, 2025, applicants for the master's program must have a bachelor's degree. 4. Learning ability: Applicants should possess good learning ability and academic performance. The required score for the previous stage of application for applicants is 75%, and for those applying for the Chinese Government Scholarship, it is 80%. Applicants can provide other proof of their learning ability or academic performance such as GRE, GMAT, etc. 5. Language Requirements The applicant should possess the required language proficiency in both Chinese and English as per the admission criteria.
